# ReFit

> ReFit cleans GPS outliers from cycling .fit activities, estimates power from physics (no power meter needed), derives FTP, TSS and power zones, and writes a valid .fit back. A web app and a CLI on one TypeScript core; everything runs in the browser — no accounts, no server. MIT.

ReFit is a static single-page app, so the crawlable HTML at this domain is only
a shell. This file and /llms-full.txt describe what the app actually does.

Key facts:

- Web app: https://dmitrytarassov.github.io/refit/ — drop a .fit file or try the
  built-in examples; rides are stored locally in IndexedDB, files never leave
  the browser.
- CLI: `bun lib/index.ts <file.fit> [--smooth] [--power ...]` — writes
  `<name>.out.fit` next to the input.
- Track cleaning pipeline: speed gate → Hampel filter (robust statistics) →
  Kalman filter + Rauch–Tung–Striebel smoothing.
- Power model: P = (F_gravity + F_rolling + F_aero + F_inertia) · v / η with
  η = 0.975; device speed is Hampel-filtered first; accuracy ±10–15% on a calm
  solo ride (wind and drafting are invisible to the model).
- Metrics: Normalized Power (Coggan), FTP estimated as a lower bound
  (max of 0.95·P₂₀, Monod Critical Power, best hour) with a manual override in
  Settings, TSS, Coggan power zones.
- Source: https://github.com/dmitrytarassov/refit (MIT license).

## Docs

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/architecture.md): directory layout, code organization rules, naming
- [Web app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/web-app.md): SPA structure, navigation, data flow, hooks
- [i18n](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/i18n.md): UI localization (en/ru), dictionaries, language storage
- [CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/cli.md): commands, flags, example output
- [FIT format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/fit-format.md): how .fit files are read and written back
- [Track cleaning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/track-cleaning.md): the three filters, parameters, results
- [Power estimation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/power-estimation.md): the physics model, CdA/Crr tables, accuracy
- [FTP estimation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/ftp-estimation.md): lower-bound estimate and the manual override
- [History storage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/history-storage.md): IndexedDB schema and flows
- [Theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmitrytarassov/refit/main/docs/theme.md): the "Ink and brass" UI palette
